ward.summary: Worli, Lower Parel and Prabhadevi (ward G/S) used ₹28.2 lakh of its ₹32.0 lakh budget, 88%, across 64 jobs. About 33% of jobs were redone within 30 days, against an expected 25%, which is in line with expectations for a flood-prone ward (flood index 0.60). Repairs that failed cost ₹10.6 lakh. No jobs are listed for review. The ward has 22 open issues costing ₹5.7 lakh to fix, starting with waterlogging at Senapati Bapat Marg and Dr Annie Besant Road. The remaining ₹3.8 lakh covers 16 of them, not all.
